BOOK ONE · LESSON 126

Have to and do not need to 不得不和不必要

不得不和不必要

A picture lesson on 'have to' (obligation) and 'do not need to' (absence of obligation), including the past form 'didn't need to' and 'had to'. Six pictures show questions and answers about having to leave immediately, getting up early, taking a taxi, waiting two hours, watering the garden and walking to the station. The lesson introduces the word immediately and written exercises on writing questions and answers, answering with have to/has to, and writing questions with have to. The workbook drills choosing between have to / don't need to / didn't need to and reacting to situations; the grammar workbook completes sentences with have to, don't need to or didn't need to and makes dialogues about school duties.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. Do you have to go now? / Yes, I have to leave immediately.
2. Do you have to get up early tomorrow morning? / Yes, I'll have to get up at six o'clock.
3. Did you have to take a taxi? / I'm afraid I had to. I couldn't get a bus.
4. Hasn't your friend arrived yet? How long have you had to wait? / I've had to wait for two hours!
5. Do you have to water the garden? / No, I don't need to water it now. It's going to rain.
6. Do we have to walk to the station? / No, we don't need to. We can catch a bus.

1. 你现在必须走了吗？/ 是的，我必须立刻离开。
2. 你明天早上必须早起吗？/ 是的，我不得不六点钟起床。
3. 你不得不打的了吗？/ 恐怕是的，我坐不上公共汽车。
4. 你的朋友还没到吗？你等了多久了？/ 我不得不等了两个小时了！
5. 你不得不浇花园吗？/ 不，我现在不必浇，天要下雨了。
6. 我们不得不走到车站吗？/ 不，我们不必，我们可以坐公共汽车。

New words & expressions 生词和短语

immediately /'ɪmɪdiətli/
adv. 立即地

Written A: Write questions and answers

抄写以下句子，然后提问并写出相应的否定句。

抄写以下句子，然后提问并写出相应的否定句。

4 items; 2 examples printed on the page (You have to leave early. → Do you have to leave early? / You don't have to leave early. She must leave early. → Must she leave early? / She needn't leave early.).

Written B: Answer these questions

用 have to 或 has to 回答问题。

用 have to 或 has to 回答问题。

4 answer items; 1 example printed on the page (I must go now. What about you? → I have to go, too.).

Written C: Write questions

模仿例句改写提问。

模仿例句改写提问。

4 question items; 1 example printed on the page (I must go now. → Do you really have to go now?).
